_comment: Quest 1 'Something in the Cisterns' FIGHT path. Loads cisterns_fight_start (warrior L1 beside Olesm at the Guild frontage, 29,4) via title Continue. Full loop: GIVE (Olesm banks heard_about_cisterns -> opens the grate + starts the `cisterns` quest) -> descend the now-open sewer_grate -> clear the shield_spiders nest (on_victory banks cleared_the_nest + resolved_the_cisterns, firing quest beat 1) -> ascend -> REPORT to Olesm (banks cisterns_reported -> beat 2 + quest_completed). Fixture rng_state governs the warrior-L1-solo fight (overrides --seed).

steps._comment: == GIVE: Olesm at (29,3). First interact plays his rotating talk_pool line; the second opens olesm_intro. ==
steps.name: interact

steps._comment: Hub cursor: 0 chess, 1 [Tactician] (locked -- warrior), 2 'You look worried about something.' -> cisterns. move_down x2, confirm.
Cisterns node fresh: the three report options are accomplishment-gated (HIDDEN), so the accept 'I'll look into it.' is the only effect option, at cursor 0.
Advanced to cisterns_brief (the what/where/how explaining beat). cursor 0 'Understood.' -> hub; cursor 1 'On it.' ends. Take 'On it.'

== DESCEND: to the grate approach (16,10) facing down. Down the guild column to y7, left to x16, down to y10. The grate's door_when gate is now MET (heard_about_cisterns) so interact transitions to the sewers landing (2,2) instead of banking heard_the_sewers. ==
== CLEAR THE NEST: shield_spiders at (15,10). Down the left walkway to (2,11), right along y11 to (15,11), bump up (sets facing) to face the nest, interact. ==
== ASCEND: back to the ladder (sewer_exit at 2,1). Left along y11 to (2,11), up to (2,2), interact the ladder -> street beside the grate (15,11). ==
== REPORT: back to Olesm (29,3). Up to y7, right to x29, up to (29,4). Same waking (no sleep), so his pool is spent -- interact opens olesm_intro directly. ==

Hub at report time: heard_about_cisterns is banked, so 'You look worried about something.' (hide_when that counter) is GONE; its in-progress replacement 'Any word on the cisterns?' (requires that counter, appended at array end) is the way back into the cisterns node. Visible: 0 chess, 1 [Tactician] (locked), 2 'I'll leave you to your tally.', 3 'Any word on the cisterns?'. move_down x3, confirm.

Cisterns node post-victory (cleared_the_nest banked, cisterns_reported not): accept is HIDDEN, watch/skill reports HIDDEN -> only 'It's dealt with -- I cleared the nest myself.' is the effect option, at cursor 0.
Opacity: no counter numerals leaked in any quest/toast text.
